boundaries: Historical listing pattern vs first-party current date check are separate evidence classes
CL2 physical and ministry/source IDs must survive; no new venue IDs
Community associations only to scope cited site and provider, no whole venue claims
Unknown and conditional remain; no public Una Cum, Pope in Canon or canonical standing
No automatic fixed Mass event recurrence from an undated directory listing

source_groups.observation: The Belgian district confirms Sunday 07:30 Low and 10:00 High, Monday/Tuesday/Thursday/Friday 18:30, Wednesday 07:30 and Saturday 10:00. This is the chapel at Hemelstraat 21, with the district directory also using 23 as the priory's address; do not resolve building ownership/entrance from this alone.
source_groups.remaining_gate: November 2026 monthly parish schedule supersedes the generic weekly listing; verify dated exceptions before occurrence publication.

source_groups.observation: The Nov 1-8 2026 Etobicoke bulletin explicitly lists Sunday Nov 1 and Nov 8 at 08:00 and 10:00 Sung, contrary to historical Sunday 10:30 and 17:00. Tue Nov 3 has 18:00, Friday Nov 6 has 07:15 and 18:00, first Saturday Nov 7 at 09:00, with feast-day variations and no fixed weekly guarantee.
source_groups.remaining_gate: Replace former 10:30/17:00 recurring hypotheses only after full site/occurrence dedup and current-week verification; cannot use historical weekday 19:00 or all Saturdays 08:00 unconditionally.

source_groups.observation: Lagos St Pius X Chapel, 69 Queen Street, Yaba: Saturday 18:00, Sunday 07:00 and 09:00; first Friday 18:00, first Saturday 09:00. First-Friday/Saturday are exceptional slots, not weekly events.
source_groups.remaining_gate: Current district list is a general schedule; verify dated exceptions and do not confuse the unrelated St Pius V site in Onitsha.

source_groups.observation: ICRSP Mauritius first-party programme identifies Tuesday-Thursday 08:30 (contact Canon), Monday/Friday 18:00 at Maison Bx Père Laval, Saturday 09:00 at that house, Sunday Sung 09:45 at Collège Saint-Joseph and last-Sunday 08:00 at Hôpital Jeetoo chapel. The weekday 08:30 section does NOT explicitly name Sainte-Thérèse as the venue on this page.
source_groups.remaining_gate: All five frozen historical records have missing original venue source IDs; preserve exact CL2 anchors without minting fake source IDs. The weekday 08:30 location must be resolved independently. Calendar list may be undated.

source_groups.observation: Capuchins at Pontchardon, Notre-Dame de Compassion: first-party community confirms Sunday 07:00 and 10:00 and weekday 07:00, with extra 16:45 sometimes; the district's own named-site listing qualifies 16:45 for first Friday and first Saturday/feasts.
source_groups.remaining_gate: Do not classify the friary as SSPX-owned just because it is in SSPX's map. First-Friday/first-Saturday extra times are conditional on local programme.

source_groups.observation: Saint-Antoine Capuchin convent at Fleurance/Aurenque lists Sundays 07:00 and 10:00, weekdays 07:00, first Friday/first Saturday/feasts at 16:45; Vespers at 17:30 is not a Mass.
source_groups.remaining_gate: Capuchins de Morgon is the named community; district listing does not confer SSPX ownership or any venue-wide Una Cum statement.

source_groups.observation: Brest Chapelle Sainte-Anne has Sunday 08:30 and 10:30, Tuesday and Friday 18:30, Saturday 11:15 in named district site listing.
source_groups.remaining_gate: Confirm local bulletin for specific upcoming dates.

source_groups.observation: Toulouse chapel lists Sunday 08:00, 09:00 and 10:30, with weekday 18:30; the weekday days are not explicitly itemized on the current site page.
source_groups.remaining_gate: Do not expand 18:30 to a guaranteed Monday–Friday recurrence without local dated bulletin.

source_groups.observation: Angoulême Chapelle Saint-Aptone is served by Fraternité de la Transfiguration; Sundays 09:00 and 10:30, first Friday 18:30, first Saturday 09:00.
source_groups.remaining_gate: Monthly first-Saturday/first-Friday constraints must survive; map placement does not make SSPX the chapel's operator.

source_groups.observation: Chemillé Saint-Joseph has Sundays 08:30 and 10:30 except Christmas/Easter (10:30 only); Friday 19:00 and first Saturday 19:00 subject to weekly notice, Wednesday to check announcements.
source_groups.remaining_gate: Suppress Sunday 08:30 on Christmas/Easter; require weekly bulletin before extending weekdays.

source_groups.observation: Assais-les-Jumeaux Notre-Dame-des-Anges under Fraternité de la Transfiguration: Sundays 09:00 and 10:30, weekdays 07:50, first Friday 18:30; Vespers 17:00 are not Mass.
source_groups.remaining_gate: Avoid SSPX-operated label; check latest local actual dates/first-Friday conditions.

source_groups.observation: Tours Saint-Grégoire lists Sunday 08:30 Low and 10:30 Sung; weekday 18:00 both school term and holidays, with confession preceding it at different times.
source_groups.remaining_gate: Do not mistakenly enter 17:00/17:30 as weekday Mass: those are confessions.

source_groups.observation: Périgueux church lists Sunday 10:30 Sung, Wednesday and Saturday 18:30 Low; first Friday 18:30 after Holy Hour. Sunday confessions 09:45 are not Mass.
source_groups.remaining_gate: Preserve exact day pattern and first-Friday exception, verify special schedules.

source_groups.observation: Limoges Saint-Martial with Fraternité de la Transfiguration lists Sunday 10:30, first Friday 18:00 and first Saturday 09:00. The historical table includes only the first two, not proof another Sunday Mass exists.
source_groups.remaining_gate: Do not infer other Masses or SSPX-operated status from directory host.

source_groups.observation: Saint-Malo Sainte-Anne Sunday 08:30 Low, 10:00 Sung. Weekday times are only on current local announcements, not stated on stable landing page.
source_groups.remaining_gate: Avoid combining Saint-Malo with similarly named Brest Sainte-Anne or Lanvallay priory.

source_groups.observation: Reims Notre-Dame de France: Sunday 10:00 normally but 11:15 at Pentecost, Christ the King, and July/August; Tue/Thu/Fri 18:30; Sat 11:00.
source_groups.remaining_gate: A blanket Sunday 10:00 during July–August and the named feasts is wrong. Preserve seasonal and feast overrides.
